notes.title: Version 1.02 Release! (Fixed a bad Oculus Bug!)
notes.notes:
We have released version 1.02 patch today to get rid of a game breaking issue! The issue was if the game was launched with the mouse and keyboard via our 2D launcher, the Oculus Grip buttons would stop working. We have since re-wrote some code to fix this problem!

Special thanks to "Cteno" for helping us test and ween down where the problem was! He was a huge help! Also, "F.Zandboer" for bringing this problem to our attention! Thanks guys!

If anyone finds any other bugs, feel free to reach out to Support@VReleased.com with details of your problem, the HMD you are using, and your computer specks. We will then help fix the problem promptly!

-The VReleased Team

notes.title: VR Patch 1.01 is live! (Added a VR Launcher).
notes.notes:
A lot of people have noticed we were not under the "VR" section of their games library. That is because we had a "Non-VR" Launcher that had options to launch VR or play in Non-VR mode.

To fix this problem, we created a "VR" launcher as well so you can choose your options in or out of VR.

We also did a couple other minor changes/bug fixes.

Special shout out to Marcus who first brought this to our attention!

-The VReleased Team
